acceptance.given: A matrix aggregate is prepared from executed case evidence whose labels have not yet been accepted as valid.

oracle.expected: The aggregate evaluation emits an invalid status for mislabeled matrix evidence and does not report a successful aggregate.
forbidden: The aggregate is treated as valid despite mislabeled matrix evidence.
A mislabeled case is accepted as equivalent merely because its command exit status passed.
oracle.observable: The repository replay-matrix aggregate receipt and its case-label validation outcome.

acceptance.when: During repository Toolchain matrix aggregation, a case evidence label is inconsistent with the bound Matrix Case.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise replay-matrix with an executed case whose evidence label does not match its bound Matrix Case and require aggregate rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate each executed matrix evidence label against its bound Matrix Case before computing aggregate success; a mismatch invalidates the aggregate.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing replay-matrix receipt schema and fail closed rather than reclassifying mislabeled evidence as successful.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix aggregate under label validation -> invalid aggregate when any bound evidence label is mislabeled.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A replay-matrix aggregate with mislabeled evidence returns an invalid/failing result and cannot be reported as successful.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has completed successfully and its Validator Capability verification has not yet been independently established.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result contains independently bound Validator Capability identity and validation evidence, including an empty authorizes set.
forbidden: Validator Capability is not independently verified by the successful Replay Result.
A successful Replay Result relies on self-reported or unbound validator capability identity.
Derived replay evidence has a non-empty authorizes set.
oracle.observable: The successful replay-package receipt emitted by the repository Toolchain replay entrypoint.

acceptance.then: Validator Capability is independently verified by the successful Replay Result.
acceptance.when: The repository Toolchain produces a successful replay-package result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inspect a successful replay receipt for independently bound validator capability identity and reject an omitted, self-reported, or authorizing capability result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require every successful replay-package receipt to independently bind Validator Capability identity and verification evidence while retaining authorizes as an empty array.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve successful replay receipt compatibility while adding only fail-closed verification of the already-required Validator Capability binding.

slice_hint.state_transition: Successful Replay Result without established independent Validator Capability verification -> successful Replay Result with independently bound capability verification.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A successful replay-package receipt independently identifies and verifies Validator Capability and declares authorizes as an empty array.

acceptance.given: An Atomic Obligation-to-witness coverage graph is available for Exact Cover evaluation.

oracle.expected: Exact Cover validation reports complete reciprocal Atomic Obligation-to-witness coverage with no unmatched witness nodes.
forbidden: An Atomic Obligation is missing a required witness link.
A witness link covers an obligation in only one direction.
An unmatched witness is included in the coverage relation.
oracle.observable: The Exact Cover validator's structural coverage result for Atomic Obligation and witness mappings.

acceptance.then: Every Atomic Obligation has complete, reciprocal, exact witness coverage.
acceptance.when: The repository Toolchain evaluates Atomic Obligation witness coverage during Exact Cover validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the Exact Cover negative selector with a removed reciprocal witness mapping and require the structural validator to report the invalid coverage graph.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate obligation-to-witness and witness-to-obligation edges as one reciprocal Exact Cover relation and reject missing, one-way, or orphan witness edges.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the Exact Cover result format while retaining fail-closed structural validation for reciprocal witness coverage.

slice_hint.state_transition: Atomic Obligation witness graph with unverified reciprocal edges -> structurally validated exact reciprocal witness graph.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The Exact Cover structural validator accepts only complete reciprocal witness mappings and rejects a missing, one-way, or orphan witness edge.

acceptance.given: Inspection of a repository-contained target package is planned or underway, and effective inspection has not yet been independently verified.

oracle.expected: The validation receipt independently records successful target inspection through the bound validator execution and rejects a target identity that lacks effective inspection evidence.
forbidden: Effective inspection is treated as verified solely from target identity or without an independent verification.
A target identity beside a command that inspected something else is accepted as effective inspection.
oracle.observable: The validate-package receipt, including the bound target manifest and detached validator probe outcomes.

acceptance.then: Effective inspection has been independently verified.
acceptance.when: The repository Toolchain validates a target package through its bounded validator capability.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute validation against a target whose recorded identity is present but whose bound validator did not effectively inspect that target, and observe rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind the target manifest identity to successful validator execution against that same target and reject identity-only or differently inspected target receipts.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the validation receipt schema and existing supported target behavior while failing closed when independent effective inspection is absent.

slice_hint.state_transition: Target inspection planned or underway without independent proof -> target inspection independently verified through the bound validator execution.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A validation receipt can succeed only when the bound validator effectively inspected the identified target package; identity-only evidence is rejected.
